# awscc_cloudwatch_access_profile (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::AccessProfile



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the access profile.
- `space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the space the access profile belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the access profile.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the access profile.
- `assume_status` (String) Whether the calling principal is authorized to assume the access profile.
- `created_at` (String) The time the access profile was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `profile_id` (String) The unique identifier of the access profile.
- `profile_type` (String) Whether the access profile is managed by the service or by the customer.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the access profile was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_access_profile.example
  identity = {
    space_id   = "space_id"
    profile_id = "profile_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `profile_id` (String) The unique identifier of the access profile
- `space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the space the access profile belongs to

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_access_profile.example
  id = "space_id|profile_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cloudwatch_access_profile.example "space_id|profile_id"
```
